dz: 皇帝君士坦丁五世在发现针对他的阴谋后,羞辱了十九名高官. 他处决了领导者君士坦丁·波多帕古罗斯和他的兄弟斯特拉季奥斯.
de: Emperor Constantine V humiliates nineteen high-ranking officials, after discovering a plot against him. He executes the leaders, Constantine Podopagouros and his brother Strategios.
